# Sebas Pros Lawn Care

> Professional, affordable leaf cleanups and lawn care in South Bend, Indiana, and surrounding Michiana towns. Free estimates: call or text 574-360-5040.

- Phone (call or text): 574-360-5040
- Estimates: free
- Website: https://sebaspros.com/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596584897221

## Leaf Services

- Leaf cleanups: Leaves cleared from lawns, beds and walkways.
- Leaf blowing and piling to the curb: Blown into neat piles at the curb for pickup.
- Leaf removal and hauling: Collected and hauled away for you.
- Full-service fall cleanups: The whole yard readied for winter.

## Lawn Care Services

- Lawn mowing: A clean, even cut.
- Weed trimming / weed wacking: Tidy fence lines, posts, trees and foundations.
- Lawn edging: Crisp borders along drives and sidewalks.
- Bush trimming: Shrubs shaped and cut back.
- General yard cleanups: Sticks, debris and overgrowth cleared out.

## Service area

- Indiana: South Bend, Mishawaka, Granger, Osceola, Notre Dame, Roseland, Elkhart, Dunlap, Goshen, Bristol, Middlebury, Wakarusa, Nappanee, Bremen, Lakeville, North Liberty, Walkerton, New Carlisle, Plymouth, La Porte, Michigan City
- Michigan: Niles, Buchanan, Edwardsburg, Cassopolis, Dowagiac, Berrien Springs, Three Oaks, New Buffalo, St. Joseph, Benton Harbor

## FAQ

### Are estimates free?

Yes. Estimates are always free. Call or text 574-360-5040, or send the form on this page.

### What services does Sebas Pros offer?

Leaf cleanups, leaf blowing and piling to the curb, leaf removal and hauling, full-service fall cleanups, lawn mowing, weed trimming, lawn edging, bush trimming and general yard cleanups.

### Do you haul leaves away, or only pile them at the curb?

Both. Choose curbside piles for municipal pickup, or have the leaves removed and hauled away.

### What areas do you serve?

South Bend, Indiana, and surrounding areas across Michiana, including Mishawaka, Granger, Osceola, Elkhart, Goshen and nearby towns in Northern Indiana, plus Niles, Buchanan, Edwardsburg and other Southwest Michigan communities. If you don't see your town, just ask.

### How do I get a quote?

Tell us your town and what your yard needs using the form, or call or text 574-360-5040.
